appln_title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR THE MOUNTING, DEPLOYMENT AND USE OF HYDROGRAPHIC SURVEYING DEVICES
appln_abstract: A vessel of generally conventional design is provided with a hydrographic survey apparatus in which the transducer of the survey apparatus is mounted on a boom swingable about a substantially horizontal axis between a deployed and stowed position. The boom is located in a slot aligned in a vertical plane along the boat's centerline and extends downward from the boat's top deck. The boom is mounted at one end near the bow of the boat by attachment to a drive shaft extending beam-wise or transversely across the slot. The drive shaft is operated by a hydraulic rotary actuator. The transducer is mounted on the free end of the boom and is swingable about the drive shaft into and out of the water. The transducer is thus selectively movable from a stowed position to a deployed position in front of the vessel where it is placed in still non-turbulent water, i.e.; water that is free from mechanical vibration and noise of the survey boat and aquatic turbulence from the hull.

appln_title: Satellite navigation and positioning unmanned aerial vehicle loaded micro monitoring equipment
appln_abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of river channel monitoring, in particular to satellite navigation and positioning unmanned aerial vehicle loaded micro monitoring equipment, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a monitor, a connecting line, a lifting device and a controller. The monitor comprises a monitoring rod and a floating plate; a detector is arranged in the monitoring rod; a cavity is formed in the monitoring rod; and a first magnet ring and an electric push rod are arranged in the cavity. The electric push rod pushes the first magnet ring to move, the first magnet ring enables the second magnet ring to move together under the action of common magnetic force of the first magnet ring and the second magnet ring, and then the second magnet ring is matched with the thrust of suspended garbage wound on the monitoring rod when the second magnet ring moves, so that the purpose that the suspended garbage in the water flow cannot make contact with the monitor during monitoring of the monitor is achieved, the risk that the unmanned aerial vehicle flies unstably for a long time and falls off due to the fact that the acting force of the water flow on the monitor is increased by the suspended garbage is prevented, and the using effect of the equipment is improved.

appln_title: Seaborne detection robot driven by both wave energy and wind energy
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a seaborne detection robot which comprises a waterborne floating body device, a middle connecting device and a power driving device. The waterborne floating body device adopts a ship-shaped structure, stabilization bodies, an airtight cabin, a solar cell panel, a GPS, a communication antenna and a sensor are arranged on the waterborne floating body device, and the airtight cabin is internally provided with a storage battery and a communication controller; the middle connecting device is a flexible cable made from special materials and can transmit electric energy, signals and kinetic energy; and the power driving device comprises a wind energy driving assembly and a wave energy driving assembly. According to the seaborne detection robot driven by both wave energy and wind energy, the purpose of making the seaborne detection robot to sail along a preset track is achieved by jointly utilizing renewable sources of wave energy and wind energy as direct driving force, an underwater glider driven by wave energy as active power to pull the waterborne floating body device to move forward underwater and thrust generated by a propeller driven by wind energy as auxiliary power and automatic cruise control of the communication controller.

appln_title: UNMANNED SUBMERSIBLE USING WAVE ENERGY AS A DRIVING FORCE AND OFFSHORE MOBILE SYSTEM USING THE SAME
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to an unmanned submersible using wave energy as a propelling force and an offshore mobile system using the same and, more specifically, to an unmanned submersible capable of providing a propelling force such that a surface boat can keep moving forward without separate energy supply by converting the vertical movement of the surface boat by waves into a continuous propelling force. According to the present invention, the unmanned submersible includes: a housing supported by a support member to a lower side of a surface boat floating on the surface of the sea; a seawater pocket installed to be contractible and expandable in the housing to suction and store seawater from the front of the housing when expanded, and to generate a propelling force by injecting the stored seawater to the rear of the housing when contracted; and a displacement plate installed to be displaceable while combined with the seawater pocket in the housing to be displaced relative to the housing due to the surface boat lifted by waves while deforming the seawater pocket to cause the front suction and rear injection of the seawater.

appln_title: Method for planning the journey of a submarine
appln_abstract: A method and system for planning the journey of a submarine are provided using at least one electrical drive with a battery for energy supply and a charging device for the battery. For a selected future point in time, the remaining available energy reserve of the battery is predicted on the basis of the travel duration up to this point in time, of at least of one consumption profile selected for the travel duration, and of the type and duration of the charging cycles of the battery being effected up to this point in time.

appln_title: Marine ecology automatic monitoring buoy system
appln_abstract: The utility model relates to a marine ecology automatic monitoring buoy system, including basic braced system, data collection and transmission system, positioning system, power supply system, instrument monitoring system, anchor system, safety assistant system. The utility model discloses an advantage embodies: in appearance, whole buoy system, it is simply generous, accord with very much modern's aesthetics, structural, the instrument is thrown in the groove and in succession mutually that to float be buoy body and turriform support on the surface of water, and whole the interlinkage is born fruit firmly, can adapt to exceedingly odious weather, in the material, adopt polyurea material and stainless steel material, have high corrosion resisting property concurrently, guarantee the life of system.

appln_title: Early warning buoy for seawater detection
appln_abstract: The early warning buoy comprises a main body, a stand column is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the main body, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the stand column, and a solar mounting base is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the mounting plate; when the buoy shakes, the closed center-of-gravity position is adjusted, so that the buoy can quickly recover to a balanced state, the stability of the buoy is improved, a detection result is prevented from being influenced, the possibility of overturning of the buoy is reduced, fresh water is obtained by distilling seawater, the survival time of survivors is prolonged, and the survival rate of the survivors is increased. In addition, when the seawater is distilled, distress signals can be generated through the antenna, so that the searching time of rescuers for survivors is shortened, and moreover, the probe is regularly cleaned through the brush bristles, and the situation that the detection precision is affected due to the fact that attachments exist on the surface of the probe is prevented.

appln_title: Novel multi -functional environmental protection navigation mark lamp
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a novel multi -functional environmental protection navigation mark lamp, include: the navigation mark lamp main part is with the complementary power generation system of navigation mark lamp main part fixed connection's clean energy, many information collection system and location and communication system, wherein: the complementary power generation system of clean energy includes solar power system, wind power generation device and wave energy power generation facility, the navigation mark lamp main part is including setting up the body in the bottom, and wave energy power generation facility sets up in body centre of gravity place's below, and solar energy power generation facility and wind energy power generation facility set up the upper surface at the body,still set up organic box and battery pack module on the centre of gravity place of body, machine box top is provided with the fairway buoy lighting fixture, and the top of fairway buoy lighting fixture is provided with the navigation mark lamp, the navigation mark lamp links to each other with battery pack module through the machine box, many information collection system and location and communication system all set up at the machine box insidely. The utility model discloses utilize solar energy, wind energy, wave energy power supply, can be automatically to sea wave, temperature and atmospheric pressure etc. The hydrometeorology key element carry out the telemetering measurement.

appln_title: On-site monitoring system for performance of elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for deep-sea buoys
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an on-site monitoring system for the performance of an elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for deep-sea buoys, and particularly relates to the field of deep-sea monitoring. The on-site monitoring system auxiliary comprises a central processing module, wherein the output end of the central processing module is separately connected with an information display module,an information storage module, an auxiliary recovery module and a driving module, and the input end of the central processing module is separately connected with a power supply module, a monitoring module, a correction module and a positioning module. According to the on-site monitoring system for the performance of the elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for the deep-sea buoys, the auxiliary recovery module is arranged, air bags are installed at a plurality of node positions on the anchorage system, a booster pump in a pressurization unit is used, outside air is conveyed into a floating ball unit through a pipeline unit, so that the retractable air bags are enabled to bulge upwards to float, the whole anchor system is directly floated in sections, people conveniently recycle theanchorage system greatly, the workload during the recycling process is reduced, and the practicability is high.

appln_title: Shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement, and belongs to the field of overall design of ships. The method comprises the steps that wave height distribution in the ship advancing direction is determined based on a radar signal, in the ship advancing direction, measured by wave measuring radar; the wave height is measured through a target wave measurement buoy; the wave height measured by the target wave measurement buoy is adopted as the standard, the wave height distribution measured by the wave measuring radar is corrected, and the wave height distribution about to be encountered by the ships in next m minutes is obtained; and according to the wave height distribution about to be encountered by the ship in the next m minutes, a seakeeping quick forecasting technique is adopted for forecasting the motion of the ships in the next m minutes, a self-adaptation correction technique based on very short-range forecasting is adopted for carrying out self-adaption correction on the measured actual motion of the ships and the motion forecast theoretically, the corrected motion result of the ships in the next mminutes is obtained and compared with a shipboard aircraft landing criterion to complete auxiliary decision making. According to the shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement, a more precise forecasting result can be obtained.

appln_title: Stable offshore floating observation device convenient to recycle
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a stable offshore floating observation device convenient to recycle. The device comprises a device main body, a solar panel, a wind power generation main body, a warning lamp,an antenna, a comprehensive meteorological sensor, a wind speed and direction sensor, a propelling propeller, a hydrology and water quality sensor, a storage battery, a solar power generation controller, an inverter, a wind power generation controller, a remote control main body, a driving motor and a central processing unit; the solar panel, a supporting frame and the wind power generation body are installed in the upper side of the device body, and the wind power generation body is located in the inner side of the supporting frame. According to the stable offshore floating observation deviceconvenient to recycle, the position of the observation device on the offshore is ensured to be fixed, the driving motor, a transmission gear and a take-up roller are arranged in a mooring rope plummet body, a mooring rope can be directly taken up, and therefore an anchor body can be taken up, the observation device can be conveniently taken up and moved, and the use efficiency of the device is improved.

appln_title: MAXIMUM WATER LEVEL DETECTING DEVICE FOR UNDERGROUND WATER
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a maximum underground water level detecting device to easily and cheaply detect a maximum ultimate water level for a limited period, smoothly remove gas generated from the bottom of a borehole in spite of small diameter of the borehole, thereby reduce errors, and perform sensitive measuring. SOLUTION: A maximum water level detecting device is made up of a stand pipe 18 which is inserted into a borehole 12 and in which the underground-water level is freely moved up and down, and a number of water vessels 30 which are connected at intervals in turn by a connecting material such as a rope 32 to be arranged in the stand pipe 18 so that they can freely be inserted into and pulled out of the stand pipe. Each water vessel 30 has a bottom-blind and lidded cylindrical part provided with a curved side face 30a conforming to the internal configuration of the stand pipe 18, a water introducing port 34 is opened to the upper position of the side face, and mounting parts for the connecting materials are provided on the upper end part and on the lower end part. Then, a maximum water lever is detected by the position of the uppermost water vessel 30 filled with underground-water during the period of measuring in the stand pipe 18.

appln_title: General purpose robotics operating system with unmanned and autonomous vehicle extensions
appln_abstract: The present invention provides a general purpose operating system (GPROS) that shows particular usefulness in the robotics and automation fields. The operating system provides individual services and the combination and interconnections of such services using built-in service extensions, built-in completely configurable generic services, and ways to plug in additional service extensions to yield a comprehensive and cohesive framework for developing, configuring, assembling, constructing, deploying, and managing robotics and/or automation applications. The invention includes GPROS extensions and features directed to use as an autonomous vehicle operating system. The vehicle controlled by appropriate versions of the GPROS can include unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) applications such as a driverless or self-driving car. The vehicle can likewise or instead include an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) such as a helicopter or drone. In cases, the vehicle can include an unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV), such as a submarine or other submersible.

appln_title: Offshore energy supply system
appln_abstract: An offshore energy supply system 1 comprising an energy supply module 2 to supply energy from an energy supply to a user 7, at least one energy supply connection means 8 for connecting the energy supply module to the energy supply, and a user connection means 4 for connecting the energy supply module to the user. The energy supply module may be configured to be located on a seabed 9. Th energy may be electrical energy. The energy may be a fuel such as hydrogen, ammonia or methanol. The connection may comprise a cable, hose or other conduit. The user connection means may comprise a buoyancy element which may be located below the sea surface. The user may be a ship, boat, or other vessel which is recharged or refuelled by the energy supply system. A remote operated vehicle may be used to facilitate the connection between the energy supply system and the user. There is also disclosed a method of installing on offshore energy supply system.

appln_title: Magnetic coupling vector propulsion omnidirectional driving underwater robot control distribution method
appln_abstract: The invention provides a control distribution method for an omnidirectional driving underwater robot propelled by a magnetic coupling vector, and the method comprises the steps: describing a control distribution problem of a multi-vector propeller as a convex optimization problem under the constraint of a nonlinear inequality; calculation of control distribution can be carried out according to nonlinear physical characteristics of the omni-directional driving underwater robot propelled by the magnetic coupling vector; meanwhile, an augmented Lagrangian penalty function method is used for solving the optimal control distribution problem, the limitation that the controlled quantity exceeds thrust saturation can be overcome, and the operation real-time performance and the control precision can also be effectively guaranteed.

appln_title: Electromagnetic mechanical brake, method and application
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an electromagnetic mechanical brake, a method and application, and belongs to the field of underwater vehicle brakes. Comprising a bevel gear pair, an electromagnet assembly and a track limiting assembly, meshing and disconnection of the gear pair are controlled through the electromagnet assembly, and the state of the brake is locked through the track limiting assembly; braking is generated through contact of the two gear pairs, contact of the two gear pairs is completed through the characteristics of zero control of the motor, cooperation with the bevel gear with spring pressure and self-alignment meshing, and therefore the limit of the friction coefficient on the braking torque is changed. A compression spring of the electromagnet assembly is combined with a special limiting groove type structure to achieve keeping or disconnection of the brake, and the braking process is stable and free of collision. The brake is in a complete structure contact mode, and the stable and reliable braking effect in the high-pressure and lubricating oil filling environment can be achieved. According to the invention, stable braking under the oil-filled environment of the underwater waterproof driving motor with the depth of more than 4000 m is realized.

appln_title: Bionic robotic fish for monitoring corrosion condition of underwater pile foundation of offshore wind plant
appln_abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power plant operation and maintenance management, in particular to a bionic robotic fish for monitoring the corrosion condition of an underwater pile foundation of an offshore wind power plant. Comprising a bionic robotic fish body, a power propeller, a buoyancy regulator, a sinking and floating air bag, an air compressor, a processor, a power manager, a multi-beam detection sonar and a sound velocity profiler are regularly arranged in the bionic robotic fish body, and a measuring ship, a master control machine room and a satellite reference/moving station are arranged outside the bionic robotic fish body. According to the design, original underground diving and autonomous cruising can be achieved, and the influence of stormy waves is reduced; by carrying the multi-beam sonar, the underwater three-dimensional image of the wind power plant can be obtained, the corrosion condition of the wind power plant can be accurately measured, a repair scheme can be quickly and accurately customized, and the operation and maintenance management cost of the wind power plant is reduced; monitoring data can be acquired nearby and calculated, the monitoring work efficiency and accuracy are improved, defects of the wind power plant are found and repaired in time, and the power generation efficiency and safety of the wind power plant are guaranteed.

appln_title: Method to detect data transmitted from multiple antennas and system thereof
appln_abstract: A method to detect data transmitted from multiple antennas, said method comprising steps of: selecting a starting data block and calling it as previous data block; defining a set of indices of bits to be checked for possible flip in the previous data block as a check candidate set; applying update rule to obtain updated data block using the previous data block and the check candidate set, wherein the update is made in such a manner that change in likelihood is positive; checking if the updated data block and several consecutive previous data blocks are the same; if yes, declare the updated data block as the detected data block; if no, make updated data block as previous data block and repeat updation of data block.

appln_title: All-weather hydrological monitoring system with water-light complementary energy
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an all-weather hydrological monitoring system with water-light complementary energy, and the system comprises a floating unit which comprises a floating part and an electrical box; the hydrological monitoring unit is arranged in the electrical box and comprises a camera and a plurality of hydrological monitoring sensors, a lens of the camera is arranged downwards, and probes of the hydrological monitoring sensors penetrate through the bottom of the electrical box and then are located below the electrical box; the control unit is arranged in the electrical box and is electrically connected with the hydrological monitoring unit and the upper computer; the power storage unit is arranged in the electrical box, is electrically connected with the hydrological monitoring unit and the control unit and is used for supplying power to the hydrological monitoring unit; the hydroelectric generation unit is connected below the floating piece through a connecting rope and is electrically connected with the electric power storage unit; and the solar power generation unit is arranged at the top of the electrical box and is electrically connected with the power storage unit. The system is applied to the field of hydrological monitoring, power is supplied to the system through hydroelectric generation and solar power generation, water-light complementary green power generation is achieved, and 24-hour all-weather hydrological monitoring is achieved.

appln_title: BUOY FOR MEASURING TSUNAMI
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buoy for measuring tsunami which can be improved in tsunami detecting ability without receiving any influence from waves. SOLUTION: In a buoy for measuring tsunami, a horizontal fin 23 is attached to the upper surface of a balance weight 22 fixed to the lower end (underwater) of a bar-like buoy main body 21 having buoyancy. Since the horizontal fin 23 functions as a resistance plate that stabilizes the buoy main body 21 in the vertical direction against ordinary waves, the influence of the ordinary waves on the main body 21 can be minimized. Since the fin 23 also functions as a detecting plate for efficiently grasping the movement of a water mass at a deeper portion of the bottom face of the main body 21 while having a certain degree of cross-sectional area against tsunami, the buoy can more easily grasp the wave height of tsunami and wave height detecting ability of the buoy for tsunami can be improved.

appln_title: Improvements in and relating to mooring systems.
appln_abstract: 1,179,904. Mooring systems GLOBAL MARINE Inc. 5 May, 1967 [9 May, 1966], No. 32278/69. Divided out of 1,179,903. Heading B7S. The mooring system for a spar buoy disclosed in this specification is identical to that described in the parent Specification 1,179,903, the claims being concerned with such a system comprising an anchor, a buoyant mooring cable secured at one end thereof to said anchor, and a mooring cable of negative buoyancy and substantially uniform weight per foot of length secured at one end to the buoyant mooring cable and adapted to be secured at the other end to the lower end of the buoy.

appln_title: High speed surface craft and submersible vehicle
appln_abstract: A water craft comprising: an elongated hull comprising a passageway having an inlet and an outlet; a pump jet disposed within said passageway intermediate said inlet and said outlet; said pump jet being configured to receive water entering said passageway through said inlet and pump said water out of said outlet, whereby to propel said hull through water; a plurality of nozzles disposed on the outer surface of said hull, aft of said inlet, wherein said plurality of nozzles are configured to release a friction-reducing fluid, whereby the friction-reducing fluid displaces water from the surface of said hull so as to diminish friction on the outer surface of said hull and facilitate high speeds.

appln_title: WAVE MONITORING SYSTEM
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently monitor waves arriving from multi-directions, while suppressing cost involved.SOLUTION: A wave monitoring system 10 includes: a plurality of buoys 12 installed around a zone CA of a construction work on-water; imaging means 14 for imaging the images of the plurality of buoys 12; analysis means for analyzing the wave generated around the zone in real time based on the image of the buoy 12 imaged by the imaging means 14; and display means for displaying an analysis result of the analysis means. A commercial PC and the like are used as the analysis means and the display means, and consequently, can be structured extremely inexpensive as compared with the conventional device for observing and analyzing the waves. In addition, the installation thereof can be easily performed. Nevertheless, since the system is designed for the purpose of analyzing and displaying the waves from the images of the plurality of buoys 12 installed around the zone CA, the waves generated in the multi-directions can be efficiently monitored.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

appln_title: Large-displacement buoyancy regulating system suitable for deep sea high-pressure environment
appln_abstract: The invention provides a large-displacement buoyancy regulating system suitable for a deep sea high-pressure environment. The system comprising an inner oil tank, an outer oil tank and a hydraulic control device, wherein the outer oil tank is mainly composed of a translucent light shell and an oil bag, the translucent light shell is provided with permeable holes, and the inner oil tank is mainly composed of a pressure-resistant shell body and an oil bag; the hydraulic control device controls the inner oil tank to pour oil into the outer oil tank when floating upward is needed, and controls theouter oil tank to pour oil into the inner oil tank when descending is needed. The buoyancy regulating system comprises three parts of the inner oil tank, outer oil tank and hydraulic control device,the parts are connected through hydraulic pipes to form a complete hydraulic loop, the hydraulic control device controls the mutual oil transfer and oil injection between the inner and outer oil tanks, the system can be suitable for the deep sea environment, can achieve module design and assembly, and the installation and integration of the system and unmanned submersible are convenient.

appln_title: Multi-mode propulsion glide submarine
appln_abstract: The invention provides a submarine, which has two functions of under water and on water surface, mainly by means of wind energy resource (rich and reusable) as power in the sea, using glide, sail, propeller three driving approaches to drive glide submarine. The submarine is comprised of vessel body, elevator, vertical tail plane, multi functions sail wing, wind power electrical generator, storage battery, electrical driving system, manpower driving system, diesel oil and electric integrative system, submarine elevating system, and live maintaining system, communications system and GPS, acoustic suscepance system (sonar system), and so on. The submarine adopts gliding wing or propeller drive under water, on water surface while with sail and propeller drive, wind power electrical generator may also be used for generating. During submarine is in underwater operation, submarine is buoyed and sunk through changing the specific gravity of submarine, such changing of gravity and buoyancy is become the power of submarine for advancing through multi functions sail wing.

appln_title: HYDROKINETIC ENERGY TRANSFER DEVICE AND METHOD
appln_abstract: A device configured for the production of hydrokinetic energy that allows the efficient capture of energy from fluid in motion, especially slow flowing fluids. The device features an innovative structural design and drive train system as well as redundancy, which allows the device to be deployed in position, placed in service and maintained over its lifetime through the use of remotely operated vehicles. The device features one or more turbines, each turbine having an open center tube. The device features a buoyancy system including a plurality of thin walled modular buoyancy chambers with a redundant (re)pressurization system and remotely operated vehicle replaceable bladder modules. Structure cavities of the device are capable of storing energy via processed energy storage liquids such as hydrogen or via gas compression in tanks and then exporting the stored energy or reconverting the stored energy into electricity.

appln_title: Self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism for AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle)
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism for an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle). The self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism comprises an eccentric battery pack, an axial adjusting module and a radial adjusting module, the radial adjusting module comprises an annular gear I, an annular gear II, a plurality of connecting rods, a small gear I and a small gear II, wherein the annular gear I and the annular gear II are provided with cross-shaped supporting frame structures, the connecting rods are fixedly connected between the annular gear I and the annular gear II, and the small gear I and the small gear II are connected through a crank I and a crank II respectively and correspondingly meshed with the annular gear I and the annular gear II. The driving self-locking mechanism is used for driving the pinion I to rotate around the axis of the annular gear I; the axial adjusting module comprises an objective table jointly supported by a small worm and a small gear II, a sliding block fixedly provided with the eccentric battery pack and a lead screw nut mechanism used for driving the sliding block to slide in a reciprocating mode in the axial direction. The gravity center adjusting mechanism is compact in structure and modular in design, not only can realize quick adjustment of the gravity center in the axial direction and the radial direction at the same time, but also can realize self-locking, and solves the problems that an existing AUV is poor in maneuverability and low in movement efficiency.

appln_title: Offshore wind plant operation and maintenance detection system
appln_abstract: The invention provides an operation and maintenance detection system for an offshore wind power plant. The operation and maintenance detection system comprises a control device, an underwater robot, a retractable device and detection equipment, the collecting and releasing device is carried on a working ship, and the collecting and releasing device is connected with the underwater robot and used for releasing the underwater robot to the position below the water surface or collecting the underwater robot to the working ship from the position below the water surface during underwater operation and maintenance detection of the offshore wind plant; the working ship is located on the water surface; the control device is integrated on the working ship, and the control device is connected with the underwater robot; the detection equipment is carried on the underwater robot; the underwater robot comprises an electronic cabin; the detection equipment is connected with the electronic cabin; according to the operation and maintenance detection system for the offshore wind plant, the risk of underwater manual operation is avoided, the underwater robot is adopted to replace a frogman to carry out operation and maintenance, and safety accidents of wind plant operating personnel can be effectively reduced.

appln_title: Mooring system and method for power generation systems and other payloads in water flows
appln_abstract: A mooring system for deploying flow kinetic power generation systems in a water flow and placing the power generation systems to a position across moving path of the water flow from an anchoring point, the mooring system comprises: a main tether; an anchor means attached to a first end of the main tether and fixed to the anchoring point; and a main sail means attached to a second end of the main tether and immersed in the water flow; wherein the power generation systems is attached to the second end of the main tether; and the relative to the main sail means creates a fluid dynamic lift force on the main sail means and pulls the power generation systems in a lateral direction with respect to the moving path of the water flow. The mooring system may also be applied to moor and deploy other payloads and devices transversely across a water flow.

appln_title: Deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system and working method thereof
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of marine exploration equipment. The system comprises a buoyancy oil bag, an oil outlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve, an overflow valve, a hydraulic motor, a throttling valve, an oil outlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, an oilstorage oil bag, a controller, an oil inlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve, a hydraulic pump, a pressure reducing valve, an oil inlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, a one-way valve, a pressure transmitter and a flow meter, wherein the controller is connected with the flow meter, the pressure transmitter, the oil outlet normally open type electromagneticreversing valve, the overflow valve, the throttling valve, the oil outlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, the oil inlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, themotor and the oil inlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve through signal lines. According to the system, electric energy can be emitted by utilizing the pressure of seawater, the working state of a reversing valve of a hydraulic system is controlled, the energy consumption in the working process of the deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system is reduced, and the working timeof deep sea equipment is prolonged.
